name: Lithuania
snapshot: A NATO frontline state hosting a permanent German brigade, governed by a Social Democrat-led coalition whose inclusion of a populist party has caused repeated rows.
culture: Lithuania was the last pagan country in Europe to convert to Christianity, in 1387, and once ruled a vast commonwealth with Poland. Basketball is close to a religion. The Hill of Crosses, covered with more than 100,000 crosses, symbolised resistance to Soviet rule. Lithuanian is one of the oldest living Indo-European languages.
society: Lithuania was the first Soviet republic to declare independence, in 1990. It has become a fintech hub, has stood up to China over Taiwan, and spends heavily on defence. Emigration has shrunk the population. Belarus has sent balloons carrying contraband across the border, forcing Vilnius airport to close repeatedly.
baseline: The Social Democrats won the 2024 election. Prime Minister Gintautas Paluckas resigned in 2025 over business dealings and was succeeded by Inga Ruginienė. The coalition's inclusion of Nemunas Dawn, led by a politician on trial for antisemitic remarks, has drawn protests.
